description: Reference verdicts for experimental hold_policy (docs/media-buy/task-reference/refine_proposals.mdx#hold-policy-experimental). Each finalize vector is a refine_proposals finalize request, the source drafts, the timing a grader observed, and the seller response or task-level error; each draft vector is a draft with its allocated products. expected.violations lists every rule the response breaks, using the codes in violation_codes; an empty list means conformant. The shape is experimental and may change with the feature.

conventions.duration: Durations are ISO 8601 day, hour, minute, and second parts only. A day is exactly 86400 seconds added to the UTC instant: no calendar, time-zone, or daylight-saving arithmetic. P1D equals PT24H.
conventions.hold_placement: The hold is placed when the seller creates the committed proposal: within the request for a synchronous finalize, or when a submitted finalize completes. Placement time is not on the wire yet, so observation.hold_placed_at is the grader-side record and is used only when present. Without it, placement lies somewhere in [observation.request_received_at, observation.response_at], and a bound is a violation only when it fails for every placement in that window; a bound that passes for some placements and fails for others is reported in expected.indeterminate and is not a violation.
conventions.bounds: For a holdable draft (effective available true) that declares them: expires_at >= placement + min_duration and expires_at <= placement + max_duration. A no-hold committed proposal has an acceptance window, not a hold, so neither bound applies.
conventions.effective_policy: A draft or product without hold_policy takes the seller hold_semantics: terms_only means { available: false }, and inventory_hold or absent means { available: true } with no durations.
conventions.adcp_version: The caller version is request.adcp_version, compared by major and minor.

violation_codes.schema_invalid: A request, draft, product, response, or task error fails its JSON Schema. A grader reports only this code for the vector.
violation_codes.min_duration_not_honored: expires_at is earlier than placement + min_duration for every possible placement.
violation_codes.max_duration_exceeded: expires_at is later than placement + max_duration for every possible placement.
violation_codes.hold_policy_not_carried_forward: A committed proposal hold_policy differs from its source draft hold_policy, including being added or dropped.
violation_codes.terms_digest_mismatch: A committed terms_digest is not the sha256 base64url digest of the RFC 8785 serialization of its commercial_terms.
violation_codes.commercial_terms_changed: A committed proposal commercial_terms differ from its source draft; finalize changes no terms.
violation_codes.experimental_feature_undeclared: A draft, committed proposal, or product carries hold_policy but the seller experimental_features omits media_buy.hold_policy.
violation_codes.hold_unavailable_without_hold: An entry whose effective policy has available false returns hold_unavailable.
violation_codes.batch_aborted_without_cause: An entry returns batch_aborted but no sibling entry failed for its own reason.
violation_codes.terms_only_committed_below_3_3: A committed proposal whose effective policy has available false is returned to a caller below AdCP 3.3.
violation_codes.unsupported_feature_without_cause: A finalize batch fails with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE although the caller is at AdCP 3.3 or later or every draft is holdable, so the version gate does not apply.
violation_codes.draft_hold_policy_missing: An allocated product declares hold_policy but the draft does not.
violation_codes.draft_available_inconsistent: A draft declares available true although an allocated product effective policy has available false.
